summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of ONIONAI. Backend pytest suite (20 tests) covers auth (login/register/wrong-pw/me), dashboard stats, batches (farmer/buyer views), public verify (known, verification_id, uninspected 404, unknown 404), storage (GET/POST note), reports (JSON + PDF), buyer role restrictions (403 on POST batches + /inspections/analyze), invalid image handling, and full farmer flow on a NEWLY created batch (create batch -> AI analyze via GPT-5.4 -> save inspection (day 1) -> verify -> dispatch approve -> dispatch complete -> public verify). All 20 tests PASS. Demo batch ON-2026-001 kept undispatched as instructed. Frontend Playwright coverage: landing hero+nav, farmer login, dashboard (all 8 stats + 2 charts + storage-alerts-panel + recent-batches-table + quick-actions), batches list (3 demo cards), batch passport (ON-2026-001 timeline/verification/status/details), storage monitoring (alert, chart, timeline days 1-3, duration, note input/submit, new-check button), reports table + report view (document, status, verification_id, storage table, download & print buttons), profile form + ai-status-card showing 'openai · gpt-5.4', logout, register (new farmer -> dashboard), buyer login (no quick-actions, ON-2026-003 hidden, /camera + /inspect + /batches/new all redirect to /dashboard as expected), public /verify (known -> verify-result + storage-history; unknown -> verify-error), mobile 390px (mobile-nav-* visible, no horizontal overflow). No blocking issues found.

issues: Non-blocking console warnings: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' emitted by ResponsiveContainer during initial mount before layout settles. Charts render correctly after mount. Consider adding explicit min-height or aspect prop to eliminate warnings.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 756 lines - could be split into routers (auth, batches, inspections, storage, dispatch, reports, verify, dashboard) for maintainability but not blocking.
Recharts ResponsiveContainer emits width(-1) height(-1) warnings during initial mount on dashboard/storage charts; add min-height or explicit aspect ratio to silence.

POST /api/batches Pydantic schema requires variety + supplier_name (both required, no defaults) - correctly documented in test but not obvious from problem statement which mentioned only quantity + center.
PUT /api/dispatch/{batch}/verify expects field 'status' (not 'decision'). Consistent naming across endpoints would help API discoverability.
